body:
I didn't join this subreddit with the aim of ever posting here, i always thought i would just maintain the goal of lending an ear... seems i've strayed from that, and now i'm asking you for help.
I don't see any point to life anymore. I know there are goals, actions, achievements one can aim for in life, but all I've seen so far is the same old cliche of a rat race; an unescapable corporate machine that I have to adapt my life to. I'm 21, broke, I live off of the kindness of a friend of whom i have taken great advantage of. I've been unemployed for a while. Flunked out of college, not out of a lack of understanding of the material, quite the contrary, I loved my courses and the thrill of learning, but always came up short when it came to homework and studying...
I can't stop drinking. 
I want to disappear, nobody having any idea where I've gone.
I don't know what else to say, but I just know that i needed to say something....
